text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the training
track...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet suddenly stops in the
middle of the
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she injured herself
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's nothing. I just popped a
blister,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to have any bandages on
you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to run some more, so I just need
to patch
this up real quick.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to run some more, so I just need
to patch
this up real quick.
choice_data_list: 念のため保健室へ行っておこう！
念のため保健室へ行きましょう！
choice_data_list_en: Want me to tape it up?
Let's go to the nurse's office, just to be safe!
Let's head to the nurse's office, just to be safe!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a nice offer. How considerate
of you.
choice_data_list: 念のため保健室へ行っておこう！
念のため保健室へ行きましょう！
choice_data_list_en: Want me to tape it up?
Let's go to the nurse's office, just to be safe!
Let's head to the nurse's office, just to be safe!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you up on that. Make sure to
get the tape
on nice and tight!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm, not bad. I think I can run on this.
Thanks. It
still hurts a little, but I guess
nothing can be done
about that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Look, I said that I'm fine. Honestly,
you're making
a big deal out of nothing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... I suppose I'd be able to run with
more peace
of mind if I get it treated
properly now...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine. I'll have the nurse look at it.
